title: Time (You and I)
year_note: Lead single, released 27 April 2020; Mordechai followed on 26 June 2020.

notes.made: After about three and a half years on the road, the band went back to their farmhouse studio in Burton in summer 2019 and produced the album with Steve Christensen. Laura Lee had taken a day of silence and filled hundreds of pages, and those pages became the lyrics: this was the first Khruangbin album with vocals on nearly every song. The album is named after a near-stranger who talked her into jumping off a waterfall on a hike and shouted her full name as she jumped.
notes.context: The band announced the album in late April 2020, a month into lockdown, with a disco single about time spent together. Grammy.com later called it a fitting anthem for a world that had just shut down. The video, by Felix Heyes and Josh R.R. King, sends comedians Stephen K. Amos and Lunga Anele-Skosana around London leaving single sandcastles in odd places. Mordechai went to number 7 in the UK and 31 in the US, the band's biggest chart showing to that point.

listen_for.where: the drums from the first bar
listen_for.note: A steady disco beat (Rolling Stone called the rhythm section crisp) with cowbell flicks on top, played by a band that used to drift.

listen_for.where: the guitar fills between vocal lines
listen_for.note: Treble heard James Brown piano licks played on guitar. Speer plays the comping parts a keyboard player would.
Laura Lee's half-spoken, airy delivery, which Treble compared to Tom Tom Club.

leads_to.title: Genius of Love
leads_to.why: A Treble reviewer heard Tom Tom Club in the vocals, and this is that band's own bass-led groove with breezy vocals, made by a rhythm section on the side.

notes.unverified: The tempo; the only BPM I found (110) is an automated estimate, so 'disco tempo' rests on reviewers calling it a disco beat. Sources list the second comedian as both 'Lunda' and 'Lunga' Anele-Skosana; Rolling Stone AU's 'Lunga' is used here. XLR8R wrongly credits the Post-it video to this song; it belongs to 'So We Won't Forget'. 'Biggest chart showing to that point' is my inference from Wikipedia's chart table (earlier albums peaked at UK 82).

culture.title: Two grown-ups, one mission
culture.line: Felix Heyes and Josh R.R. King directed it, with comedians Stephen K. Amos and Lunda Anele-Skosana as two adults on a childlike mission.

culture.title: Mordechai
culture.line: First single from Mordechai, released April 27, 2020. The album followed June 26 and reached number 31 in the US and number 7 in the UK.
